bandReport.notes: Density is a strict 4 items per page across the whole band: p1=1-4, p2=5-8, p3=9-12, p4=13-16, p5=17-20. Item 1 opens page 1 whole and item 20 ends complete at the foot of page 5 c2, so nothing spills past either band edge. COLUMN CROPS: on all five pages the split line falls just to the RIGHT of the right column's item number, so each item number for the c2 items is rendered at the far right edge of the pNN-c1 crop and is clipped off the left edge of pNN-c2 (c2 opens with a bare '.' or a fragment). No sentence or option text is sliced and no text crosses the gutter, so the c1/c2 attribution is unaffected; the numbers were confirmed off pNN.png for every page. All 20 items were transcribed from the column images; pNN.png was additionally consulted for p1, p3 and p5 to confirm digits (Q11 and Q19/Q20). PRINTED AS-IS, NOT MY TYPO: several option blocks are inconsistent about the word 'only' - Q11 (b) reads '1, 2 and 4' while (a) and (c) carry 'only'; Q15 (a) reads '1 and 2' and (c) reads '1 and 3' with no 'only' while (b) and (d) carry it. Both were re-read against the whole-page scan and are exactly what the booklet prints. The booklet uses French spacing (a space before ':' and '?'), preserved verbatim. Statement lists are numbered 1./2./3., not roman numerals. Q19's statement list is set with tighter leading and hanging indents than the rest of the paper - a typesetting difference only, content unambiguous. Scan quality was better than warned (rendered at 200 DPI per _render.json, not 150); nothing was genuinely illegible and no digit or single letter was guessed.
